title: Open Values Register Evidence Review
description: The record of a person checking the sample of entries in one evidence bundle against the register and the option mappings, and approving or rejecting it. Reviewers write it by hand, and only an approved receipt whose bundle has not changed lets the evidence into the catalogue.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-register-evidence-review.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

registerId.description: The id of the register the reviewed evidence comes from.

snapshotId.description: The id of the snapshot the reviewed evidence was built from.

evidence.description: Path of the evidence bundle this receipt reviews, under pipeline/registers/evidence/. Each bundle has at most one receipt.

evidenceSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the bundle file as reviewed. If the bundle changes, the hash no longer matches and the receipt stops counting.

status.description: approved means the sample checked out and the bundle may be promoted into lenses. rejected means it did not.

reviewedBy.description: Who did the review: a person's name or the name of the review pass.

reviewedOn.description: The date of the review, as YYYY-MM-DD.

samples.description: One row per entry in the bundle's review sample. The entry ids must be exactly the ones the bundle names in reviewRequirement.

entryId.description: The entry checked, written as cid/entityCode.

mappingChecked.description: Always true: the reviewer confirmed the option is the legal entity it was mapped to.

sourceChecked.description: Always true: the reviewer confirmed the facts against the public register.

note.description: What the reviewer compared and found, in a sentence.
